svg.title: Fuzer architecture
svg.desc: Sources and logic feed the register of asset entities and the common work model; IOC and field surfaces, Ops IQ and the APIs sit on top, and approved updates go back to the systems of action.
svg.text: Triage, dispatch, hand over, close out
Phone, iPad and desktop; installable for the field
Matched across sources: crosswalk, golden values, dated links, review queue
Runs on the register, opens cases
